name: AIZO Group Berhad
overview: 今年公司主要推进两项新业务布局：Bituminous Products 板块就 Sarawak 的 Green Bitumen Facility 与 K2 Bitumen 签署并持续更新 MOU；Others 板块通过子公司 AIZO Capital 以 RM1,000,000 收购 NetRunner 全部股权，NetRunner 此前与公司就 Sarawak 的 Tier 4 Data Center Hub 签署 MOU。同时公司完成股本削减，并分两批完成部分私下配售。
overview_en: During the year, the company mainly advanced two new business initiatives: the Bituminous Products segment signed and continued to update an MOU with K2 Bitumen for a Green Bitumen Facility in Sarawak; the Others segment, through subsidiary AIZO Capital, acquired 100% of NetRunner for RM1,000,000, with NetRunner having previously signed an MOU with the company for a Tier 4 Data Center Hub in Sarawak.

segments.name: 沥青产品
segments.note: 今年就 Sarawak 的 Green Bitumen Facility 与 K2 Bitumen 的 MOU 多次更新，截至最新公告尚无进一步重大进展。
segments.note_en: This year, the MOU with K2 Bitumen for a Green Bitumen Facility in Sarawak was updated several times, with no further material development as of the latest announcement.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: AMI 与 K2 Bitumen 就 Sarawak 设立及运营 Green Bitumen Facility 的潜在合作签署 MOU，本次公告为更新，尚无进一步重大进展。
actions.text_en: AMI entered into an MOU with K2 Bitumen to explore potential collaboration in the establishment and operation of a Green Bitumen Facility in Sarawak; this announcement is an update with no further material development.

segments.name: 其他

segments.note_en: This year, AIZO Capital acquired 100% of NetRunner for RM1,000,000; NetRunner had previously signed an MOU with the company for a Tier 4 Data Center Hub in Sarawak.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 全资子公司 AIZO Capital 与 Mr Tew Boon Teik 签署 SSA，以 RM1,000,000 收购 NetRunner 500,000 股普通股（100% 股权）；NetRunner 此前与 AIZO 就 Sarawak 的 Tier 4 Data Center Hub 签署 MOU。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary AIZO Capital entered into an SSA with Mr Tew Boon Teik to acquire 500,000 ordinary shares (100% equity interest) in NetRunner for RM1,000,000; NetRunner had previously signed an MOU with AIZO for a Tier 4 Data Center Hub in Sarawak.
